verified_facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of Thalia Mara Hall, the Russell C. Davis Planetarium and the Hinds County Courthouse.

verified_facts.text: The Mississippi Coliseum is about one mile from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located just one mile away from our contemporary hotel, The Mississippi Coliseum is home to concerts, special events, sporting events and more.

verified_facts.text: The Music Legends of Mississippi package lets guests play exact replica guitars of six pioneers of American music in their room.
verified_facts.excerpt: showcasing exact replica guitars from six legendary pioneers of American Music. Guests are invited to play one of these legendary replicas in the comfort of their own guest room when they book our Music Legends of Mississippi package.
